title: Template Story
subtitle: A small example for new story packs.

intro.title: The First Choice
text: You stand at the edge of a quiet town and the road splits in two.
Either path may lead to a bigger story, but only one will keep your nerve.

choices.label: Take the road to the market
Follow the river toward the old bridge

market.title: Market Day
text: The market is busy and full of gossip. A merchant offers a bargain that could change your future.

choices.label: Buy the map and keep moving
Skip the bargain and head for the bridge

bridge.title: Old Bridge
text: The bridge creaks above the river. A stranger warns you the water can carry a secret if you are brave enough to listen.

choices.label: Cross quickly and keep the mission secret

ending.title: The Road Opens
text: You leave town with a new sense of purpose and the first hint of a wider world waiting beyond the horizon.

ending.title: The Road Opens
ending.summary: You complete the template story and are ready to build your own world.
